work_handoff.title: N20｜Do Not Touch Things — Start Moving Inward｜Candidate 04
requirements: Generate exactly one N20 Candidate 04.
Clean Regeneration. Do not pixel-edit Candidates 01–03 and do not use them as image references.
9:16 vertical cinematic audio-comic still.
Rear-3Q conversational walking two-shot inside the castle.
Ning and Jun walk together at the same apparent slow conversational speed.
Ning is only slightly ahead: approximately half a shoulder / small natural offset, never a full stride or full body length.
Jun is同行, not追赶; preserve natural lateral conversational spacing.
Use modest step lengths and naturally different gait phases without creating different walking speeds.
Ning continues speaking while walking and may turn his head only slightly toward Jun.
Jun may naturally angle attention slightly toward Ning while continuing forward.
No physical contact; N19 shoulder touch has ended.
Never rotate either character toward camera merely for facial visibility.
Character identity is the highest visual gate: match the Ning and Jun Character Reference Sheets and N19 canonical current-production appearance.
N19 controls actual on-screen appearance, hairstyle mass, wardrobe appearance, relative body proportions and render-language continuity only.
Do NOT inherit N19 pose, shoulder contact, shared outward gaze, doorway pause, camera angle or composition.
Rear-3Q atomic anchors support orientation only and must not redesign either character.
Preserve Ning black jacket, black trousers and dark footwear.
Preserve Jun light blue-gray jacket, white inner layer, dark blue jeans and canonical dark footwear.
Environment remains CASTLE_ENTRANCE → INTERIOR TRANSITION ZONE even though Scene Master is not an image input.
Primary lighting is dim warm interior sconces/candles/chandeliers.
No direct exterior sunlight may spill across the walking floor or directly illuminate either character.
Only weak ambient evidence of brighter exterior may remain far behind if needed.
Keep interior depth limited; do not create a long corridor or full First Hall establishment.
exclusions: Candidate 01/02/03 as image references or edit bases
one character clearly chasing the other
Ning more than a small half-shoulder lead
same gait phase for both characters
